name: @dudousxd/nestjs-catalog-secrets-aws
description: AWS KMS secret vault for @dudousxd/nestjs-catalog: envelope encryption with a per-secret data key, the secret's kind and field bound as KMS encryption context, and the resolved key ARN recorded on every row.
author: Davide Carvalho
//sideEffects: Safe to be false: nothing here runs at import time. Every export is a class, a pure function or a declaration, and the only I/O is a KMS call inside seal/open. Lets a host that imports the vault type without wiring the module drop the rest.
//peerDependencies: @aws-sdk/client-kms is a PEER, not a dependency, matching @dudousxd/nestjs-catalog-store-clickhouse's handling of @clickhouse/client. A host with no AWS in it must not acquire an AWS SDK by depending on the catalog; and a host that does run on AWS almost certainly already pins a version of the SDK, which a bundled copy would sit beside rather than share — two credential-provider chains and two HTTP agents in one process.
